title: Trajectory-Wise Certification for Vector-Field Mirror Descent with Deterministic Finite Differences
summary: We study mirror descent in which the objective gradient is replaced by a general vector field. Since such a field does not automatically relate the mirror update to the objective gap, we introduce a trajectory-wise generalized relative-smoothness condition and a generalized star-convexity interface. Together they yield a finite-horizon, a posteriori last-iterate certificate with an accumulated-stepsize term and an exceptional-region-dependent error term.
